        AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),
        Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42),
        BackgroundTransparency=1,
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
        Image=logoId,
        ImageColor3=Theme.White,
        ZIndex=206,
        Parent=launcher
    })

    local launcherHit = Overlay(launcher,nil,207)
    makeDraggable(launcherHit,launcher)

    launcherHit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Tween(launcher,.14,{
            BackgroundTransparency=.04,
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(68,68)
        })
    end)

    launcherHit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Tween(launcher,.14,{
            BackgroundTransparency=.14,
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(64,64)
        })
    end)

    -- RC1.2 PERMANENT SERENITY ORB
    -- The orb is always visible. It toggles the main window rather than
    -- acting as a restore-only launcher.
    local minimized = false
    local launcherPointerDown = false
    local launcherDragStart = nil
    local launcherDragged = false

    launcherHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            launcherPointerDown = true
            launcherDragged = false
            launcherDragStart = input.Position
        end
    end)

    Track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not launcherPointerDown or not launcherDragStart then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if (input.Position - launcherDragStart).Magnitude >= 7 then
                launcherDragged = true
            end
        end
    end))

    Track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            launcherPointerDown = false
            launcherDragStart = nil
        end
    end))

    function Window:IsOpen()
        return main.Visible and not minimized
    end

    function Window:Minimize()
        if Window._OpenPicker and type(Window._OpenPicker.Close) == "function" then
            pcall(function() Window._OpenPicker:Close() end)
        end

        if minimized or not main.Visible then
            minimized = true
            main.Visible = false
            launcher.Visible = true
            return
        end

        minimized = true
        launcher.Visible = true

        Tween(
            main,
            .18,
            {
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width*.92,height*.92),
                BackgroundTransparency=.55
            }
        ).Completed:Wait()

        main.Visible = false
    end

    function Window:Restore()
        if main.Visible and not minimized then
            launcher.Visible = true
            return
        end

        minimized = false
        launcher.Visible = true
        main.Visible = true
        main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width*.92,height*.92)

        Tween(
            main,
            .20,
            {
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height),
                BackgroundTransparency=.14
            }
        )
    end

    function Window:ToggleVisibility()
        if Window:IsOpen() then
            Window:Minimize()
        else
            Window:Restore()
        end
    end

    launcherHit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        -- Dragging the orb should reposition it, not toggle Serenity.
        if launcherDragged then
            launcherDragged = false
            return
        end

        Window:ToggleVisibility()
    end)

    function Window:Close()
        if Window.Destroyed then
            return
        end
        Window.Destroyed = true

        if Window._OpenPicker and type(Window._OpenPicker.Close) == "function" then
            pcall(function() Window._OpenPicker:Close() end)
        end

        for _, connection in ipairs(Window.Connections) do
            pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
        end
        table.clear(Window.Connections)

        for i = #Window.Cleanups, 1, -1 do
            pcall(Window.Cleanups[i])
        end
        table.clear(Window.Cleanups)

        if Library._ConnectionSink == Window.Connections then
            Library._ConnectionSink = nil
        end

        if gui then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end

    Window.Destroy = Window.Close

    topButton("search",showTopProfile and -310 or -100,function()
        Window:ToggleSearch()
    end)

    topButton("close",-16,function()
        Window:Close()
    end)

    topButton("minimize",-58,function()
        Window:Minimize()
    end)

    makeDraggable(topbar,main)

    function Window:Open()
        minimized = false
        launcher.Visible = true
        main.Visible = true
        main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(94,60)
        main.BackgroundTransparency = .60

        Tween(
            main,
            .20,
            {
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,60),
                BackgroundTransparency=.24
            }
        ).Completed:Wait()

        Tween(
            main,
            .24,
            {
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height),
                BackgroundTransparency=.14
            }
        )
    end


    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- OFFICIAL PICKER DISMISSAL
    -- One picker at a time already exists in V13. RC1 adds the same
    -- outside-click/tap behavior as V14 mobile for contract parity.
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function pointInside(guiObject, position)
        if not guiObject or not guiObject.Parent or not guiObject.Visible then
            return false
        end
        local p = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
        local s = guiObject.AbsoluteSize
        return position.X >= p.X and position.X <= p.X + s.X
           and position.Y >= p.Y and position.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
    end

    Track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local active = Window._OpenPicker
        if not active then
            return
        end

        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
            pcall(function() active:Close() end)
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end

        if pointInside(active._Selector, input.Position)
        or pointInside(active._Menu, input.Position) then
            return
        end

        pcall(function() active:Close() end)
    end))


    return Window
end



return Library
